### Observed differences

- In the later window, activity A01 appears in all 200 traces (mean 1.0) and is positioned near the end (mean position 0.93); it was completely absent in the earlier window. [OCC001, POS001]
- A02 participation rose from 48% to 100% of traces, and its outgoing transitions shifted from A03 (56%) and A07 (44%) to A06 (91%), with small shares to A12, A07, A11 and A03. [OCC002, DIR002]
- A06 participation rose from 52% to 100%, and its mean occurrences per trace rose from 1.09 to 2.11, with recurrence (multiple occurrences) rising from 26% to 53% of traces. [OCC003]
- A15 and A16, which previously led only to each other, now also lead to A01 (about 50% each). [DIR004, DIR005]
- A01 now co-occurs with every other activity in the later window; before it was absent. Many pairs that previously did not co-occur (e.g., A02-A06, A02-A12, A03-A06, A05-A06) now co-occur in all traces. [REL001-REL009, REL012, REL015, REL018, REL021]
- The distance between A02 and A03/A07 increased from 1-2 steps to 3-5 steps; A15-A16 distance changed from always 1 step to sometimes 2 steps. [LAG001, LAG003, LAG007, LAG008]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports a change in which a new activity A01 was added near the end of the process, and the main path was altered so that A02 now leads to A06 (which is repeated more often) instead of A03/A07, with A01, A15 and A16 forming a closing loop. This is supported by the appearance of A01 in all later traces, the shift in A02's outgoing edges, the increased occurrence and recurrence of A06, and the new connections from A15/A16 to A01. The large number of qualified items (58 vs 0.53 expected) makes chance an unlikely explanation.

Other differences: A11 participation increased from 26% to 53%, A12 from 52% to 100%, and many activity pairs now co-occur and are interleaved, indicating a more repetitive or looped execution. A competing explanation that cannot be fully ruled out is that the earlier window simply did not sample rare variants, but the magnitude and consistency of the changes make this unlikely.
